entries.what: Caught the 6:48 Tule Line from Flats Junction with a large masala chai from Anh's cart, then went to MWF classes at Bayshore State.
entries.outcome: Got to campus early and stayed awake through the morning.

entries.what: Emailed the Model UN officers to drop out, which leaves the supply chain club, PSA treasurer and the case team.
entries.outcome: Model UN is off his calendar.

entries.what: Worked his 10-hour week at the career center front desk in the afternoon, checking people in for appointments.
entries.outcome: Finished the shift and left with a lighter schedule.

entries.what: Back at Marisol Gardens, noticed a neighbor's guest settling in next door for the week; Judith had moved into Elliot's spare room. Edited the resume until late.
entries.outcome: Went to bed late again.

entries.what: Rode the 6:48 and sat through Dr. Ashby's 10:30 operations management lecture on tote flow.
entries.outcome: Took pages of notes ahead of Thursday's midterm prep.

entries.what: Tuesday 3 p.m. standing mock interview with Lena, answering 'tell me about yourself' on his feet.
entries.outcome: Lena gave notes on pacing; he is still stiff but kept showing up.

entries.what: Ate his rajma-and-rice container for dinner and tracked two new applications in the spreadsheet.
entries.outcome: Spreadsheet updated.

entries.what: MWF classes 9-12 on campus after the early train.
entries.outcome: Made it through without a late arrival.

entries.what: Studied for the operations management midterm at the library with sticky-e-key laptop, then did his LinkedIn outreach to one alum.
entries.outcome: Sent the day's alum message.

entries.what: Texted roommate Marcus a reminder about groceries before his shift and made tea so the apartment stayed quiet in the morning.
entries.outcome: Marcus got his sleep.

entries.what: Took the operations management midterm in Dr. Ashby's 10:30 class.
entries.outcome: Finished with time to spare, unsure about two questions.

entries.what: Went to Dr. Ashby's Thursday office hours at 2 to ask about the letter timeline and knocked despite the closed door.
entries.outcome: Ashby reminded him the letter is on track.

entries.what: Did laundry in the card-only machines at Marisol Gardens on Thursday night while Thao and Marcus's building buzzed about the St. Anselm union vote.
entries.outcome: Clean clothes for the week.

entries.what: Rode the 6:48 and went to MWF classes; the Egrets homecoming banners were up around town.
entries.outcome: Short day on campus.

entries.what: Sunita called with news that a former colleague agreed to refer him into Harrowgate Distribution.
entries.outcome: Got the contact and a link to apply with the referral.

entries.what: Tailored resume v19 for Harrowgate that evening and submitted with the referral name.
entries.outcome: Application submitted a day later than he wished, but on time.

entries.what: Ran the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop, about four miles.
entries.outcome: Cleared his head.

entries.what: Met his case competition team to work on slides for Nov 8.
entries.outcome: Divided up sections of the deck.

entries.what: Bought groceries at Ruiz Family Market and stayed under the $450 monthly budget.
entries.outcome: Stocked up for Sunday meal prep.

entries.what: Sunday dinner at his parents' Pell Road house, took home a tub of dal.
entries.outcome: Mom asked about internships, so he told her about the Harrowgate referral.

entries.what: Helped Sunita with the wedding vendor spreadsheet over the phone.
entries.outcome: Sorted vendor columns by price.

entries.what: Meal-prepped four containers of rajma and rice.
entries.outcome: Lunches ready for the week.
